en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a long neoclassical colonnade packed with people strolling along a promenade beside a narrow river or canal. Behind the colonnade rise wooded hills and several grand multi‑storey spa hotels or villas. The printed caption at the top in red reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnen - Kolonnade." A small red vertical imprint at the right edge gives the publisher information.
